claude.sample_unit: Google People Also Ask resources and ChatGPT responses

links.outcome: Proportion of Google and ChatGPT patient education resources meeting universal readability criteria
links.effect: 6% of Google resources met universal readability criteria; 20% of ChatGPT responses met them when asked to write for the appropriate audience; ChatGPT more readable than Google.
links.quote: 78% of the Google resources answered the associated PAA question, and 6% met the criteria for universal readability.

unlisted_practices: Prompting ChatGPT to write for the appropriate audience to improve readability of patient education materials
